description: D1: the first time the giant is frozen fast (Events.rime_frozen): how to get out of it and how to keep it off.
text: Frozen fast! Throw a heavy blow to shatter the ice off you. Rime builds from his breath, his blows, his cold and the open water; it falls away from your own heavy blows, by a fire, and with time. A bigger body keeps its heat.
